purpose: Structural fields the per-token operator dependency graph (src/opentallas/critical_path.py) needs and that a model profile does not already carry. The graph is built from ModelProfile fields first -- hidden size, layer count, experts, attention groups and the per-layer attention_sequence, plus metadata.operator_config and the head fields where the profile states them -- and from the entry here only for what the profile leaves out. A model with no entry here, or an entry that leaves a required field unstated, is REFUSED by critical_path.decode_shape: an unknown structure is never defaulted to another architecture's. Every value below is copied from the model's pinned Hugging Face config.json (revision and sha256 given per entry, byte-identical to the file the profile adapter hashed) unless its own note says otherwise. Model profiles are deliberately not edited, because their digests are bound elsewhere.
grade_definitions: published: copied from the released config.json at the pinned revision. assumed: a structural reading the config does not state; the note says why.

DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-engram-hbm.note: placement variant: same decoder, Engram tables in the KV store; the lookup is token-addressed and prefetched, so the graph is the base model's

structure_notes.note: Two config keys have no public reference implementation pinned in this repository and are read structurally, not measured. routed_expert_hidden_size 3584 with latent_moe_use_norm is read as a LATENT MoE: the hidden state is projected 7168 -> 3584 and normalised before the routed experts, which run at 3584, and projected back after the combine (two extra dependent matrix passes per MoE layer). attn_res_block_size 12 is read as a block attention-residual: each layer's input is a softmax-weighted mix over up to 12 earlier block outputs, one dependent reduce-exp-reduce-scale chain per layer. Both are charged on the critical path; if either reading is wrong K3's serial chain is over-charged, never under-charged.
